title: ComfyUI curated model catalog
description: Validates services/comfyui/models.yaml — the curated SoT for ComfyUI models. The wizard ALSO live-scrapes HuggingFace and civitai; user additions go in services/comfyui/custom-models.yaml.

name.description: Stable unique identifier used as the catalog key and DB name column.

category.description: Category drives the in-container target directory (CATEGORY_TARGET_DIR) and wizard display group.

url.description: Curated artifact URL pinned to an immutable 40-hex Hugging Face revision.

files.description: Optional bundle files. When present, one logical catalog entry expands to one download row per file.

family.description: Display family label (e.g. 'SDXL', 'AnimateDiff'). Defaults to name if absent.

size_gb.description: Approximate disk size in GB. Surfaced in wizard; used for disk-space warnings.

size_bytes.description: Exact artifact size in bytes when known from an immutable upstream revision.

sha256.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 digest. Required for every direct curated artifact.

target_dir.description: Override in-container subdirectory under /models. Defaults to CATEGORY_TARGET_DIR[category] when absent.

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum GPU VRAM in GB. Adds a badge when the host has less.

min_ram_gb.description: Recommended host or unified memory in GB, surfaced as a wizard badge.

cpu_supported.description: If false, adds a 'requires GPU' badge. Defaults to true.

requires_custom_node.description: ComfyUI custom-node repo names required to use this model (warn-only badges).

popularity.description: Approximate popularity score (0-100). Used for wizard sort order.

cloud_only.description: If true, the model is only available via cloud API, not for local download.

notes.description: One-line subtitle shown in the wizard option row.

filename.description: Explicit on-disk filename. Required for civitai URLs whose URL path carries no real filename.

essential.description: If true, this entry is activated by default when COMFYUI_USER_MODELS is empty (DB-free replacement for the former essential column in public.comfyui_models).

provisioning_required.description: Whether a selected artifact must provision successfully before ComfyUI can become ready. Defaults to true; optional is explicit.

precision.description: Preferred numeric precision for this logical model.

variant.description: Human-readable artifact variant, such as mps-safe or fp8.

host_constraints.description: Optional host constraints for the logical model, such as mps or cuda.

license_name.description: Human-readable model-weight license name shown during selection.

license_url.description: Pinned authoritative license URL for the model weights.

license_restrictions.description: Material operator obligations shown as warn-only wizard badges.

role.description: Stable role within the bundle, e.g. diffusion, text_encoder, vae, checkpoint.

target_dir.description: Explicit in-container subdirectory under /models. Defaults from category when absent.

provisioning_required.description: Optional per-file override of the logical model's readiness policy.
